text_block_list.text:
Since Victoire Pisa wasn't feeling well, I 
brought her to the infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for causing you concern... 
What about the Trainer—
choice_data_list:
Don't worry about me, make sure you get 
proper rest.

Don't worry about me— just make sure you 
get some proper rest.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu... Yes. In that case, I will gladly 
take you up on that offer.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Nn... Where am I? I'm pretty sure I was 
resting in the infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...My goodness. Look at all these untied 
ribbons...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text: Let's tie them all together again...♪

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear. That plug and this plug are all 
unplugged... I need to plug them back in.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
My, my, my. The paper chain we were making 
is...!

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Phew. This paper chain garland has gotten 
quite long, hasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, you look like you need help. Are 
you lost, perhaps?"

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
The sky... wait, could it be outer 
space...? Is your home out in the cosmos?

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. Don't worry, everything's going to 
be okay. I'll be sure to connect it for 
you.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
"Even so, what should we do? If only we 
had something long..."

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...I know! We can attach balloons to that 
paper chain garland...

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Ah... What a relief. I was able to deliver 
it safely.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
A handshake? Hehe... of course. Since 
everyone's here, let's all form a circle.

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
...Fufufu. It seems we've connected with 
aliens as well.

After having a fun dream, Victoire Pisa 
got right back into top form.
